title: pteris lanuginosa var. capensis
intro: Pteris lanuginosa var. capensis, commonly known as the Cape lily fern or Cape feather fern, is a plant species in the family Pteridaceae. It is a type of fern native to South Africa, known for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pteris lanuginosa var. capensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
